statement: The annotation-blind MOP16-14-v1 representation will retain non-random three-domain signal: the number of distinct real masked token types shared by ECOLI, PYRO, and YEAST will exceed every one of five exact-dinucleotide-preserving null triplets generated under the frozen seed schedule.
test: Execute exactly the global test in 21_MASKED_OPCODE_PREREG_v1.md using all 120 masks. No A2451 target result may be interpreted unless this global gate passes.
support_condition: real_all_three_MOP_count > max(five dinucleotide-null all-three MOP counts)
weakening_condition: Real exceeds the null mean but not the maximum; record as MIXED and do not treat the representation as globally validated.
falsification_condition: real_all_three_MOP_count <= dinucleotide-null mean or otherwise fails to exceed the null distribution as specified.
contamination_boundary: Frozen before any real-genome MOP16-14 token generation, global count, null count, or target lookup.
